lines.en: label chikadorm5:
I knock on the door and wait for Chika to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，等 Chika 来应门。

lines.en: In doing so, I'm also risking the possibility of Yumi answering and then promptly amputating one of my limbs, but that is a risk I am willing to take at this point in time.
lines.zh: 这么做也有风险——开门的可能是 Yumi，然后她会当场卸掉我一条胳膊或腿。但此时此刻，我愿意冒这个险。

lines.en: Especially since I can't imagine a future in which I'm only allowed inside of some of the dorm rooms and not all of them.
lines.zh: 毕竟我无法想象一个只能进部分宿舍房间、而不是全部的未来。

lines.en: I'm counting on you, Chika. Please be here.
lines.zh: 全靠你了，Chika。拜托你一定要在。

lines.en: : Come in! Door's open!
lines.zh: : 进来吧！门没锁！

lines.en: scene black
I'm invited in with no hesitation, likely because Chika assumes I'm one of the girls.
lines.zh: 她毫不犹豫地让我进去了，多半是因为 Chika 以为我是哪个女生。

lines.en: But even though I'm aware of this, I decide against saying anything since my words would become just one more obstacle in what I'm already making out to be a great opportunity.
lines.zh: 但尽管心知肚明，我还是决定不点破——因为在这我自认为绝佳的机会面前，我的话只会成为又一道障碍。

lines.en: Here goes nothing, I guess.
lines.zh: 管他呢，豁出去了。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm1
: Woah! You're certainly an unexpected visitor.
lines.zh: : 哇！你可真是个意想不到的访客。

lines.en: : Surprise.
lines.zh: : 惊喜。

lines.en: : Surprise indeed. What's up? Did you need me for something?
lines.zh: : 确实够惊喜。怎么了？找我有事？

lines.en: : Not anything in particular. Just wanted to see what you were up to and you just happened to not be in the hallway this time.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的。就是想来看看你在干嘛，碰巧你这次没在走廊上。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm2
: Well, yeah...I just wish you would have told me in advance so I could like, prepare myself and stuff.
lines.zh: : 呃，是啊……我只是希望你提前跟我说一声，让我好歹做点心理准备什么的。

lines.en: : Prepare yourself for what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 准备什么？

lines.en: : Umm...the...unfamiliar wave of emotions that comes from having a boy in my room for the first time?
lines.zh: : 呃……就是……第一次有男生进我房间，那种陌生的情绪波动啊？

lines.en: : Oh, right. You're anti-boy.
lines.zh: : 哦对，你恐男。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm3
: I'm not anti-boy, Sensei! I told you I'm just not super experienced when it comes to like, you know, dating and all that stuff.
lines.zh: : 我才不恐男呢，Sensei！我跟你说过，我只是对那种……你知道的，约会之类的事没什么经验。

lines.en: : Well if it makes you feel any better, I am not here to date you.
lines.zh: : 好吧，如果这能让你好受点的话——我不是来跟你约会的。

lines.en: : Why are you rejecting me before either of us has asked the other one out?!
lines.zh: : 我们俩谁都还没约谁呢，你干嘛先拒绝我啊？！

lines.en: : Can I be in here or not? Because I can't really tell with the way you're acting right now.
lines.zh: : 我到底能不能待在这儿？看你这反应我实在看不出来。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm4
: Of course you can be in here...
lines.zh: : 你当然可以待在这儿……

lines.en: : Well, at least until Yumi gets back, I mean.
lines.zh: : 呃，至少在 Yumi 回来之前吧。

lines.en: : It just feels a little sudden, you know? Like...I sleep in here.
lines.zh: : 就是感觉有点突然，你懂吧？毕竟……我可是在这儿睡觉的。

lines.en: : And if I hadn't finished cleaning like, five minutes before you showed up, you would have seen all of my clothes all over the floor and it would have totally ruined any opinion you have of me.
lines.zh: : 而且要不是我在你来之前五分钟刚收拾完，你就会看到我衣服扔得满地都是，那我在你心里的形象就全毁了。

lines.en: : You're right. My opinion of you hinges entirely on the frequency of your laundry routine.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我对你的看法完全取决于你洗衣服的频率。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm5
: Why do I feel like every single thing I've added to this conversation so far has been me digging myself into an even deeper hole?
lines.zh: : 为什么我觉得这场对话里我说的每句话都是在给自己挖更深的坑？

lines.en: : Because you're nervous. Relax. I'm just here to hang out.
lines.zh: : 因为你紧张。放松点，我就是来坐坐。

lines.en: if mall10 == True:
: Unless you want to pick up where you left off in the dressing room the other day. I'd just want to wash my hands first and-
lines.zh: : 除非你想接着那天在更衣室里没做完的事继续。那我得先洗个手——

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm6
: Ahhh!!!! No no no no no no! Stop right there! We don't talk about that anymore!
lines.zh: : 啊——！！！不不不不不不！打住！那件事我们不提了！

lines.en: : Why not? I figured you'd be a little more confident now that you're in your own room.
lines.zh: : 为什么不提？我以为你在自己房间里会自信一点。

lines.en: : Granted, confidence didn't really seem to be the issue at the mall and-
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，在商场的时候你好像也不缺自信——

lines.en: : And nothing! Nothing happened at the mall! Unless...you wanted something to happen at the mall! Which is a thing I still can't really wrap my head around!
lines.zh: : 没有然后！商场里什么都没发生！除非……你当时想让它发生什么！这事我到现在都想不通！

lines.en: : I don't even like thumbs!
lines.zh: : 我又不喜欢什么拇指！

lines.en: : You should probably stop yelling, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你最好别喊了，Chika。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm6r
: Yeah. Yeah, okay. I'm good. Good and completely mature and not acting irrationally at all.
lines.zh: : 好。好，行。我没事。没事，非常成熟，一点都没不理智。

lines.en: : Just...a totally innocent girl hanging out with her totally unsuspecting teacher...all alone in...a bedroom and...
lines.zh: : 就是……一个清清白白的女孩子，跟她毫无防备的老师……单独待在……一间卧室里……

lines.en: : Oh boy...
lines.zh: : 完蛋了……

lines.en: else:
scene chikafirstdorm4
: Sensei, any girl in their right mind would be a little nervous right now. It's not just a me thing.
lines.zh: : Sensei，任何神志清醒的女孩子这时候都会有点紧张的。不是我一个人这样。

lines.en: : I just figured the whole age gap thing would-
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得年龄差这事会让你——

lines.en: : That doesn't...really change anything for me. You're still a guy and there's no way for like, a person to keep themself from falling for somebody even if everyone else thinks it's not the right person or whatever.
lines.zh: : 那对我来说……其实没差啦。你还是个男的，而且一个人喜欢上谁是拦不住的，就算别人都觉得那是对的人还是不对的人。

lines.en: : The only thing that really changes is like, I guess how I'd act around that person? I don't know. It's hard to...put into words.
lines.zh: : 真正会变的大概就是……我在那个人面前的表现吧？我也不知道。很难……用话说清楚。

lines.en: : Like, if I ever wound up liking somebody your age, I doubt I'd just up and tell them about it.
lines.zh: : 比如，要是我哪天真喜欢上你这种年纪的人，我大概不会直接告诉对方。

lines.en: : What? Why not?
lines.zh: : 啊？为什么不告诉？

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm2
: Well...isn't the older person supposed to make the first move in situations like that?
lines.zh: : 呃……这种情况不都该是年纪大的那方先主动吗？

lines.en: : I just...kinda figured that's how that went.
lines.zh: : 我就是……一直以为是这样的。

lines.en: : I don't really think there's a rulebook when it comes to that, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这种事没有什么规则手册，Chika。

lines.en: : Well...there should be. Because it would definitely make a lot of stuff a lot easier for me to understand right now.
lines.zh: : 呃……那也该有一本。因为它绝对能让我现在搞明白很多事。

lines.en: It's times like this that really reinforce just how inexperienced Chika is when it comes to romance.
lines.zh: 这种时候就特别能看出来，Chika 在恋爱方面有多没经验。

lines.en: I’m sure that she'd be incredibly popular with guys if there were actually any around.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，要是周围真有男生的话，她一定会非常受欢迎。

lines.en: She’s already well-liked by pretty much all of the girls in the school...so I can only imagine how things would be with the opposite sex.
lines.zh: 她在学校里几乎所有女生都喜欢她……所以我只能想象她面对异性时会是什么样。

lines.en: : Hey, Chika.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Chika。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm7
: Yeah? What's up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, what sorts of guys are you into?
lines.zh: : 纯粹好奇，你喜欢什么样的男生？

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm7r
: Wanna borrow my notebook so you can write it all down?
lines.zh: : 要不要借我的笔记本，好让你全记下来？

lines.en: : I think I'll be fine with just mental notes, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我记在脑子里就行，谢谢。

lines.en: : Well, pay close attention then. Cause there's kind of a lot of stuff that I like and my soulmate would have like, at least 50%% of these qualities.
lines.zh: : 那你可得听仔细了。因为我喜欢的东西还挺多的，我的灵魂伴侣至少得具备这些特质的 50%。

lines.en: : I'd assume a soulmate would have 100%% of them, but sure. Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 我以为灵魂伴侣得 100% 全中，不过行吧，你说。

lines.en: : I guess I’d like somebody...dependable.
lines.zh: : 我想我喜欢那种……靠得住的。

lines.en: : Somebody who could look after me if I got sick or...help me figure out how to pay bills or something like that.
lines.zh: : 我生病时能照顾我，或者……帮我搞明白怎么交账单之类的。

lines.en: : Someone who would take me shopping and be honest with me when I try something on and it doesn't look great.
lines.zh: : 会带我去逛街，试穿不好看时会跟我说实话。

lines.en: : But...I’d also want them to be really down to earth and...sensitive and stuff too.
lines.zh: : 但……我也希望他很踏实……还有细腻体贴什么的。

lines.en: if cafe15 == True:
: Them? Not him?
lines.zh: : 他们？不是他？

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm8
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 啊？什么意思？

lines.en: : I just haven't heard you specifically mention this person also having to come equipped with a penis yet.
lines.zh: : 我只是还没听到你特别提到这个人还必须自带那话儿。

lines.en: : I mean...I don't know. I don't really think they do?
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道哎。我觉得不一定非得是？

lines.en: : I don't think I'd be opposed to dating a girl if the right one came along. I've just kind of only been attracted to guys so far.
lines.zh: : 要是遇到合适的女生，我也不排斥跟她约会啦。只是我到目前为止只对男生有过感觉。

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: I guess maybe there’s a little hope for Rin after all?
lines.zh: 这么说，Rin 也许还有点希望？

lines.en: else:
: I see. I guess that makes sense for a girl your age.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。你这个年纪的女生这样想也正常。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm9
: Now, hmm...let’s see...
lines.zh: : 接下来，嗯……让我想想……

lines.en: : What else do I like?...
lines.zh: : 我还喜欢什么来着……？

lines.en: : Oh, well obviously, it would have to be someone I’m physically attracted to. So probably older and taller and stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，很明显，得是我外表上有感觉的人。所以大概是年纪大一点、高一点之类的。

lines.en: : I think glasses are kinda cute too. And muscles.
lines.zh: : 我觉得戴眼镜也挺可爱的。还有肌肉。

lines.en: : I'm beginning to think you might be intentionally describing me here.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得你是在故意描述我了。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm6r
: And someone who could be really gentle...but also a little wild at times...
lines.zh: : 还要那种可以很温柔……但偶尔也有点野的……

lines.en: : Chika?
lines.zh: : Chika？

lines.en: : Someone who likes biting...
lines.zh: : 喜欢咬人的……

lines.en: : Someone who-
lines.zh: : 还要——

lines.en: : Chika.
lines.zh: : Chika。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm10
: Huh? What? Hi.
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？嗨。

lines.en: : How much did I say?
lines.zh: : 我刚才说了多少？

lines.en: : There was something about biting.
lines.zh: : 说了些关于咬人的。

lines.en: : No there wasn't.
lines.zh: : 才没有。

lines.en: : Oh. My bad. Must have been the wind.
lines.zh: : 哦，是我听错了。大概是风声吧。

lines.en: Yeah, I'm pretty confident that this will be going somewhere in the near future.
lines.zh: 是的，我相当确定，这事在不久的将来会有进展。

lines.en: if mall10 == True:
Granted, I kind of figured that out the second my thumb went into her mouth, but now I'm really sure.
lines.zh: 不过说句实话，自从我的拇指伸进她嘴里那一刻起我就隐约猜到了，但现在是彻底确定了。

lines.en: else:
How near remains to be determined, but there is absolutely no way Chika is just dropping all of these hints on accident.
lines.zh: 有多近还不好说，但 Chika 绝对不可能是无意中抛出这些暗示的。

lines.en: I don't know much about her yet, but I can tell she's smarter than that.
lines.zh: 我对她了解还不多，但我看得出来，她没那么笨。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm7
: Hey, do you wanna like, sit down or something?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你要不要……坐下来什么的？

lines.en: : I feel kinda bad just making you stand there like that when you probably walked all the way over here...
lines.zh: : 你大老远走过来，我却一直让你站着，我有点过意不去……

lines.en: : I'm getting pretty used to walking, so it's not a big deal. But yeah, we can sit.
lines.zh: : 我已经很习惯走路了，没什么大不了的。不过行啊，坐吧。

lines.en: : Cool! Is...
scene chikafirstdorm10r
: Is the bed okay? Or would that be like, weird or something?
lines.zh: : 坐床上行吗？还是会有点……奇怪什么的？

lines.en: : It wasn't going to be weird. But it might be now that you said that.
lines.zh: : 本来不奇怪的。但你这么一说，可能就有点了。

lines.en: : Can we...pretend I didn't say that then? Cause the only other option is the couch and one of the cushions has a broken spring in it that makes weird noises and-
lines.zh: : 能不能……当我没说？因为除了床就只有沙发了，而沙发有个坐垫弹簧坏了会发出怪声——

lines.en: : The bed is fine, Chika.
lines.zh: : 床就可以，Chika。

lines.en: : Cool. Yeah. Bed it is, then.
lines.zh: : 好。嗯。那就坐床吧。

lines.en: scene black
Chika takes a moment to compose herself before leading me over to the bed and sitting down.
lines.zh: Chika 花了点时间平复情绪，然后领我走到床边坐下。

lines.en: She turns the TV on for some reason, which I don't fully understand since she immediately mutes it, but I guess that doesn't matter right now.
lines.zh: 她不知为何把电视打开了，这点我没太看懂，因为她紧接着就按了静音——不过现在这也不重要了。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm11
Her blanket is one of those obnoxiously fluffy ones that air can’t get through, making it easy to surmise that she likely sleeps with minimal clothing on- a thought I shouldn't be having right now.
lines.zh: 她的毯子是那种蓬松到不透气的款式，由此不难推断，她睡觉时大概率穿得很少——我现在不该有这种想法。

lines.en: Actually, no. That is absolutely a thought I should be having right now.
lines.zh: 不对，恰恰相反。我现在绝对应该有这样的想法。

lines.en: This girl invited me onto her bed despite the obvious blooming attraction between us.
lines.zh: 这个女孩明明感觉到了我们之间正在萌发的那种吸引，却还是邀请我坐她的床。

lines.en: She wants me to think those things.
lines.zh: 她就是想让我往那方面想。

lines.en: And I'm sure she'd be in the same exact position I'm in if I were the one to invite her over to my place instead.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定，换成我邀请她来我家，她也会处于跟我一模一样的境地。

lines.en: : So! Now that we've talked about my ideal partner...could you maybe tell me a little bit about yours?
lines.zh: : 那么！既然聊完了我的理想型……你能不能也跟我讲讲你的？

lines.en: : Do you need a notebook? Or will you also be employing the mental note strategy?
lines.zh: : 你需要笔记本吗？还是也打算用记脑子里这招？

lines.en: : I think my memory will suffice.
lines.zh: : 我记性够用了。

lines.en: : Then...let's see...
lines.zh: : 那么……我想想……

lines.en: : The quality that's most important to me would probably be...
lines.zh: : 对我来说最重要的特质大概是……

lines.en: menu:
Looks
lines.zh: 外貌

lines.en: : Probably looks, despite how superficial I'm sure that sounds.
lines.zh: : 大概是外貌吧，尽管这听起来肯定很肤浅。

lines.en: : I just can't imagine being with someone I'm not physically attracted to.
lines.zh: : 我只是无法想象跟一个外表上不吸引我的人在一起。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm12
: No, yeah! I totally get that! I'm the same way!
lines.zh: : 不，我懂！我完全理解！我也是这样！

lines.en: : Like, I don't think I'd say looks are the most important quality, but they're definitely, like...super important. You know?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我不会说外貌是最重要的特质，但它绝对……超级重要。你懂吧？

lines.en: : What, umm...what kinds of girls are you the most attracted to, if you don't mind me asking?
lines.zh: : 那，呃……你不介意我问的话，你最喜欢哪种女生？

lines.en: : Tan, blonde ones who wear too much pink and decorate their walls with other, equally attractive girls.
lines.zh: : 皮肤晒成小麦色、金发、穿一身粉红、墙上贴满其他同样好看的女孩子的那种。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm13
: Hmm...I wonder if I know anybody like that?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我好像认识这样的人哎？

lines.en: : If you do, could you maybe set me up? Preferably with one who doesn't mind me hanging out in her room all the time.
lines.zh: : 要是认识的话，能不能帮我撮合一下？最好是不介意我老待在她房间里的那种。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm13r
: Yeah. I'm pretty sure I could find you somebody like that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我敢肯定能帮你找到这样的，Sensei。

lines.en: : They're really sensitive, though, so you'd have to be super nice to them all the time.
lines.zh: : 不过她特别敏感，所以你得当个超级温柔的人才行。

lines.en: : Nice isn't really a strong point of mine, but I'll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 温柔不是我的强项，不过我尽量吧。

lines.en: Innocence
lines.zh: 清纯

lines.en: : Innocence, I guess?
lines.zh: : 大概是清纯吧？

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm12r
: Innocence? I’m innocent!
lines.zh: : 清纯？我很清纯啊！

lines.en: : I have no idea why that's the most important quality to you, but I'm totally okay with it!
lines.zh: : 我不知道为什么这对你来说是最重要的特质，但我完全没意见！

lines.en: : It certainly appears that way.
lines.zh: : 看起来确实是。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm11r
: Oh, uhh...Sorry. I just...
lines.zh: : 哦，呃……抱歉。我只是……

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Innocence can mean like, a bunch of different things, though. So...what are you referring to exactly?
lines.zh: : 不过清纯可以有很多种意思哎。所以……你具体指哪种？

lines.en: : Cause you already know I don't have any experience with guys. But, at the same time, I'm not the same type of innocent as somebody like...I don't know. Sana.
lines.zh: : 因为你已经知道我没跟男生交往过。但与此同时，我又不是那种……我不知道，像 Sana 那种清纯。

lines.en: : So do you mean like, experience innocent? Or...personality innocent? Cause I'm a little bit of both of those things, but...definitely more of the first one.
lines.zh: : 所以你是说经历上的清纯？还是……性格上的清纯？因为我两种都沾点边，但……肯定更偏第一种。

lines.en: : Using Sana as the benchmark for the opposite end of the spectrum kind of insinuates that she has experience with men and that makes me feel very strange.
lines.zh: : 你把 Sana 当成另一个极端的标杆，这等于在暗示她有跟男人交往的经验，让我感觉很奇怪。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm13
: Idunno. Maybe she does? Who are we to hold her back?
lines.zh: : 不知道哎。也许她真有？我们又没资格拦着她。

lines.en: : If you need an answer, I'm not really sure which of those two sides I lean towards.
lines.zh: : 如果你非要个答案，我自己也不太确定我更偏向哪一种。

lines.en: : It's like asking me what the most important side of a coin is when they're both equally valuable.
lines.zh: : 这就像问我硬币哪一面最重要——明明两面都一样有价值。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm11
: Right. Except tails is definitely the more important side and we all know it's true.
lines.zh: : 有道理。不过反面绝对更重要，大家都知道这是真的。

lines.en: Sex
lines.zh: 性

lines.en: : ...Sex, I guess?
lines.zh: : ……大概是性吧？

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm14
: ...What? Really?
lines.zh: : ……什么？真的假的？

lines.en: : That's...the most important thing to you? That's not even a quality. I thought we were talking about, like...personality traits.
lines.zh: : 那是……对你最重要的？那都算不上是特质。我以为我们在聊……性格之类的。

lines.en: : I guess calling it the most important quality isn't really accurate. But I don't think it's wrong to use it as a barometer to determine how potentially successful a relationship can be.
lines.zh: : 我想称它为最重要的特质确实不太准确。但拿它当晴雨表来判断一段感情能走多远，我觉得也没什么不对。

lines.en: : That's just...such a...
lines.zh: : 那真是……好……

lines.en: : Like, coming out and just admitting it like that takes balls.
lines.zh: : 就这么直接承认，真有你的。

lines.en: : Obviously my word means like, literally nothing here since I've never even kissed anyone before, but...I don't know. I just feel like that's such a tiny part of what love is.
lines.zh: : 显然我的话在这里毫无分量，毕竟我连吻都没接过，但……我不知道。我只是觉得那只是爱情里很小很小的一部分。

lines.en: : Love wasn't really what you asked about, though.
lines.zh: : 可你问的不是爱情啊。

lines.en: : Huh?
: You asked what I'd look for in a partner. Not every relationship needs to be about love, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你问的是我找伴侣看重什么。不是每段感情都得跟爱有关，Chika。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm14r
: I guess I...didn't really think of it like that.
lines.zh: : 我想我……没往那方面想过。

lines.en: : Huh.
The two of us sit in silence for a while as our gazes bounce back and forth from the depths of each other's eyes to the muted television.
lines.zh: 我们俩沉默地坐了一会儿，视线在彼此的眼眸深处和那台静音的电视之间来回游移。

lines.en: They'll occasionally lock onto each other for short bursts of time that ultimately equate to nothing but slight nudges in the direction we both know we're heading.
lines.zh: 偶尔，两道视线会短暂地交汇，那不过是朝我们彼此都心知肚明方向的一次次轻推。

lines.en: And of course, I'm not the one to break the silence when its time is finally diminished.
lines.zh: 当然，当沉默终于走到尽头时，打破它的不会是我。

lines.en: I likely never will be, either.
lines.zh: 大概永远都不会是我。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm11
: Oh! Umm, I’ve been meaning to ask you, but do you think that you might be able to help me study some time?
lines.zh: : 哦！呃，我一直想问你，你以后能不能帮我补习功课？

lines.en: : I am your teacher, so I'm pretty sure I'm supposed to say yes.
lines.zh: : 我是你的老师，所以我想我应该答应。

lines.en: : Okay, awesome! Cause like, I'm really into the whole no tests thing, but I don't really want my mind to start, like...melting. You know?
lines.zh: : 好，太棒了！因为我超喜欢现在这种没考试的日子，但我也不想让我的脑子开始……融化掉。你懂吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I don't think I'd worry about it melting, but yeah. I get it.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我倒不担心你的脑子会融化，不过我懂你的意思。

lines.en: : Just let me know when and I'll do whatever it is I can.
lines.zh: : 你想补习的时候告诉我就行，我会尽我所能。

lines.en: scene chikafirstdorm15
: Thanks, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei。

lines.en: : You know...when I first joined your class, I never would have even imagined the two of us being able to talk like this.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我刚进你们班的时候，根本想象不到我们俩能这样聊天。

lines.en: : But...I really like it. And I like you, like...being here or whatever.
lines.zh: : 但……我真的很喜欢这样。也喜欢你……待在这儿什么的。

lines.en: : I'm probably gonna start talking in circles if I don't cut myself off but, like...I guess what I'm trying to get at is that you...
lines.zh: : 我再不打住就要语无伦次了，不过……我想说的是，你……

lines.en: : You can come by whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你随时可以过来。

lines.en: : Well, so long as Yumi's not here.
lines.zh: : 呃，只要 Yumi 不在就行。

lines.en: : That's good enough for me, Chika. I'll drop by as often as I can.
lines.zh: : 对我来说这就够了，Chika。我会尽量常来的。

lines.en: : Okay...cool.
lines.zh: : 好……太好了。

lines.en: : The door's always open.
lines.zh: : 门永远为你敞开。

lines.en: scene black
Chika walks me to the door and awkwardly wraps her arms around me for a few seconds before allowing me to leave.
lines.zh: Chika 送我到门口，笨拙地伸手抱住我几秒，然后才放我走。

lines.en: I think about hugging her back, but get distracted by something on the wall.
lines.zh: 我想回抱她，却被墙上的什么东西分了心。

lines.en: I forget what that something is on the way home.
lines.zh: 在回家的路上，我已经忘了那是什么了。
